نَشْءٌ and ↓ نَشِىْءٌ Risen clouds: (K:) or the first that rises of them: (S, K:) or their first appearance: (ex. لِهٰذَا السَّحَابِ نَشْءٌ حَسَنٌ These clouds have a good first appearance:) or clouds when they appear like a piece of drapery (مُلَآءَة) spread out. (TA.) ―
-b2- نَشْءٌ The exhalation, or odour, of wine. (IAar.) [See 10.] ―
-b3- See نَاشِئٌ. ―
-b4- Also, The young ones of camels: (Kr, K:) pl. [or rather quasi-pl. n.] نَشَأٌ. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
